prompt:
Generate a graph with 19 vertices that is colorable with at most 4 colors, has girth (shortest cycle) at least 7, and has at least 37 edges.

Return the graph as a list of edges (u, v) with 0 <= u < v < 19, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no graph exists.
